basic_details.job_title: Collector & District Magistrate, Jangaon Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: One Staff Nurse post on outsourcing basis at TGMR School (Boys), Jangaon is open to female candidates only, under Notification No.19/2026 of the Office of the Collector & District Magistrate and Chairman, District Outsourcing Committee, Jangaon (Government of Telangana). The application must be submitted in person at TGMR School (Boys), Jangaon, between 10 November 2026 and 13 November 2026 (till 2.00 PM on the last day). The written exam is on 15 November 2026 at 11.00 AM.

content_sections.heading: About Jangaon District Staff Nurse
content_sections.text: The recruitment is conducted by the Collector & District Magistrate of Jangaon district in Telangana, who is also Chairman of the District Outsourcing Committee. The notification was forwarded by the District Employment Officer (FAC), Jangaon. The Staff Nurse will be posted at TGMR School (Boys), Jangaon, and will work under the administrative control of the District Minority Welfare Officer, Jangaon.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The application is not sent by post or email. It must be handed in person at TGMR School (Boys), Jangaon . Fill in the prescribed application form (the notice calls it the Resume/Bio data form). Attach self-attested copies of the certificates listed under Enclosures, along with a passport-size photograph. Submit the form in person at TGMR School (Boys), Jangaon, from 10.11.2026 to 12.11.2026 between 10.30 AM and 5.00 PM. On 13.11.2026, the last day, applications are received till 2.00 PM only. The notice does not attach a specimen of the application form or say where the form can be collected.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Who can apply: Eligible female candidates only. Qualification: 1. B.Sc.(N) or GNM; 2. Registered with TS Nursing Council. Age limit: Minimum age is 18 years and maximum age is 44 years. The notice does not print a cut-off date for counting age or any age relaxation. Pay: Rs. 27,000/- per month. The remuneration shall be paid as prescribed by the Government, subject to applicable rules and instructions. Nature of engagement: Purely on an outsourcing basis, made through the existing outsourcing agency/new outsourcing agency, as appropriate. Candidates must possess the prescribed educational qualifications and satisfy the prescribed age limits and eligibility conditions; the full details are in the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Self-attested copies of the following must be enclosed with the application form: SSC certificate Qualifying certificates Marks memos Study / residence certificates (1st to 10th class) Caste certificate Experience certificate A passport-size photograph

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection will be on merit through a written examination and/or interview to be held on Sunday, 15 November 2026, and the result will be displayed on the Jangaon District website for transparency. Written exam: 15.11.2026 at 11.00 AM at Main Conference Hall, IDOC Complex, Collectorate, Jangaon District. Hall ticket: Hall tickets can be downloaded from the Jangaon District website ( https://jangaon.telangana.gov.in/ ). What to bring: Any valid identity proof, a black/blue ball point pen and an exam pad only. Medical test: With the consent of the candidate, the medical test will be conducted by the DM&HO, Jangaon in the premises of the IDOC, Jangaon. Verification: All relevant original certificates relating to educational qualifications, age and other eligibility conditions shall be verified before engagement. The notice does not give the exam pattern, syllabus or marks.

The selected person shall discharge the duties assigned to her by the District Minority Welfare Officer, Jangaon. The District Collector, Jangaon, reserves the right to cancel or modify the notification in accordance with Government instructions and administrative requirements.

faq.question: Q1. How many Staff Nurse vacancies are there in Jangaon District Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 01 Staff Nurse post on outsourcing basis at TGMR School (Boys), Jangaon.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the Jangaon Staff Nurse post?
faq.answer: The last date is 13 November 2026 till 2.00 PM. From 10 to 12 November 2026, applications are received between 10.30 AM and 5.00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. Can male candidates apply for this Staff Nurse post?
faq.answer: No. The notification invites applications from eligible female candidates only.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is required for the Jangaon Staff Nurse post?
faq.answer: Candidates need B.Sc.(N) or GNM and must be registered with TS Nursing Council.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the Jangaon Staff Nurse post?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 18 years and the maximum age is 44 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of the Jangaon Staff Nurse?
faq.answer: The remuneration is Rs. 27,000/- per month, paid as prescribed by the Government, subject to applicable rules and instructions.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for the Jangaon Staff Nurse post?
faq.answer: Submit the prescribed application form with self-attested copies of certificates and a passport-size photograph in person at TGMR School (Boys), Jangaon, by 13 November 2026, 2.00 PM.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Jangaon Staff Nurse post?
faq.answer: Selection will be on merit through a written examination and/or interview on 15 November 2026, with the result displayed on the Jangaon District website.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the Jangaon Staff Nurse written exam be held?
faq.answer: The exam is on 15 November 2026 at 11.00 AM at Main Conference Hall, IDOC Complex, Collectorate, Jangaon District; hall tickets can be downloaded from the Jangaon District website.

faq.question: Q10. Is the Jangaon Staff Nurse job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is purely on an outsourcing basis and does not confer any right for regular appointment or permanent absorption in Government service.
